text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As promised, El Condor Pasa shows up for
training the following day.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
She's fearless, she's bold, she's El Condor
Pasa! Having overcome her
injury, she
makes her triumphant return to the ring!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello and good morning. You're
awfully calm, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
So I gotta know! What kind of extremo
training are we doin' today?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Is it gonna be thirty laps at top speed?! Or
maybe hill sprints until the
sun goes
down?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Running around town while givin' you a
piggyback ride doesn't sound
bad either!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I see, I see, I see! Some light joggin'—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Wait, whaaat?! Sorry, did I hear you right
just now? Trainer, could you
repeat that?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The exact same sentence—word-for-word!
What are you, stuck on
repeat?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Why?! Why are you doin' this to me,
Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I am the Umamusume who will one day become the world's strongest racer! The condor who will rule over the skies of champions!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Do you really think I have even a second
to waste on dillydallying on
the ground?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Grr... Urghhh!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...I understand. I'll run—for now. But if you
change your mind, tell me
right away,
okay?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Sigh... How am I supposed to soar the skies with this kind of normal training?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her complaints, El Condor Pasa
makes her way to the dirt
track and begins
running.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I finished that light jog you wanted
me to do, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Qué? Uh, they're fine... No pain at all in
either leg.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, don't tell me!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you made me do light training
because you were worried
about my legs?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, no need to make a fuss! If I'm
gonna prove myself as the
world's
strongest racer, then we don't have time to
worry about this
kinda stuff!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Agh. You're right about that, but... But!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I'm sad, shocked, even disappointed. I was really lookin' forward to your training program, you know.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Could it... Could it be that you never
actually believed in me from the
start?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Did you think that fundamentals training
was just right for a
loudmouth like El
Condor Pasa?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I bet you don't even believe that I could
become the world's strongest
racer, do
you?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Urk! S-such fiery eyes! That's the passion I
know and love!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: B-but now I'm even more confused! If what you said is true, then what's this training for?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Condition my body?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa is still growing. If she
pushes herself too much now,
there's a
chance she might develop a chronic injury.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain to her that's why I want her to do
training that suits her
current strengths so
that one day, when she's ready, she'll have
a
body ready to truly become the world's
strongest racer.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...I see. I see, I see—I totally understand.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Um, actually, you lost me with all the lingo
in the middle. But at the
very least...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I get that you're serious about training me!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
So... there's something I want to ask you.
And I want you to put your
all into this
answer!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The world's strongest racer—she flies
across the turf at the speed of
light!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And her name is?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Correct! Bueno!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You replied with zero hesitation, which
means you really do believe in
me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa flashes me a satisfied smile.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Why don't we do this again from the
top?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Just wait riiight there!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Here I go!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Blam! The lightning-quick Umamusume
who runs through storm and
squall! Her
name—El Condor Pasa!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Also known as... your new trainee! She's
here and reeeady to
ruuumble!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And on that note... Trainer, I'm looking
forward to our new
partnership!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, I took my first step towards
soaring the skies with El Condor
Pasa!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now, with that over, let's get back to
training! Wanna run with me,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Picture it—beside the world's strongest
Umamusume stands her
trainer, the world's
strongest muscle behemoth! I think we
could make
it work, don't you?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Wait up, Trainer! Don't be like that!
Come back! Why are you
running?!
